plan.goal: Evaluate the UX of a static ChatGPT clone, focusing on the chat interface interaction flow, sidebar navigation, and responsive layout constraints.
plan.summary: The run will validate the primary chat loop (input -> simulated streaming response) and secondary flows like history navigation and pricing. It will specifically test the 'fake' AI behavior to ensure the typewriter effect feels natural despite being hardcoded. Finally, it will audit mobile responsiveness given the prescan warnings about small tap targets.
assumptions: The site is a pure frontend mock; no real API calls are made.
AI responses are triggered by keyword matching in script.js, not semantic understanding.
Authentication pages (login/signup) are visual mocks and do not persist state.
risk_hotspots: Mobile tap targets: Prescan indicates multiple elements <44px height/width.
Sidebar toggle: Ensuring content reflows correctly when sidebar is closed.
Input area: Verifying the textarea auto-resizes or scrolls with long text.
Streaming simulation: Checking if the setInterval typewriter effect blocks UI or feels laggy.

phases.title: Primary Chat Interaction & Simulation
phases.objective: Validate the core loop: sending messages, receiving simulated streaming responses, and using post-response controls.
key_checks: Send a generic message to trigger a default/hardcoded response.
Observe the 'typewriter' streaming effect for smoothness.
Test 'Regenerate' to see if it cycles through different hardcoded responses.
Test 'Copy', 'Thumbs Up', and 'Thumbs Down' for visual feedback states.
Test 'Attach file' and 'Voice input' buttons for expected UI reactions (even if non-functional).
exit_criteria: At least two distinct conversation turns completed.
All post-message action buttons clicked and visually verified.

phases.title: Navigation & History Management
phases.objective: Ensure sidebar interactions, history switching, and view toggles work without breaking layout.
key_checks: Click existing history items (e.g., 'Travel planning request') to load that context.
Click 'New chat' to reset the main view.
Toggle 'Close sidebar' and verify main content expands/reflows correctly.
Use 'Search chats...' input to filter the history list.
Click 'Explore GPTs' and 'Upgrade plan' links to ensure routing works.
exit_criteria: Navigated to at least one historical chat and back to new chat.

phases.title: Monetization & Auth Flows
phases.objective: Verify the structure and navigation of the pricing and authentication pages.
key_checks: On Pricing: Toggle between 'Monthly' and 'Annual' to check for price updates.
On Pricing: Click 'Get started' or 'Upgrade' to check navigation logic.
On Login/Signup: Verify form layouts and social login button presence.
Check links between Login and Signup pages ('Don't have an account?', 'Already have an account?').
exit_criteria: Auth page navigation loop (Login <-> Signup) verified.

phases.title: Mobile Responsiveness & Accessibility Audit
phases.objective: Re-evaluate critical paths on mobile viewport, focusing on the prescan's tap target warnings.
key_checks: Specifically attempt to tap 'Thumbs up/down' and 'Copy' buttons (identified as small targets).
Verify sidebar opens/closes cleanly on mobile (hamburger menu behavior).
Check if text in the chat window remains readable and doesn't overflow horizontally.
exit_criteria: Critical chat functions usable on mobile despite small tap targets.
No horizontal scrolling issues in chat bubbles.

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all 4 HTML files (index, pricing, login, signup).
coverage_targets.features: Exercise all visible buttons in the chat footer (attach, voice, send) and message actions (copy, vote, regenerate).
coverage_targets.mobile: Full pass on index.html and pricing.html to document touch target usability.

notes: Since the AI is fake, do not expect coherent follow-up answers unless keywords match the hardcoded logic.
Focus UX critique on the *feel* of the streaming animation and the clarity of the UI states rather than content accuracy.
